hazards.evidence: Stove with visible knobs and oven door; no indication of knob covers or safety locks, posing risk of accidental activation by someone with dementia.
Cleaning chemicals (e.g., dish soap) visible on the sink counter, within easy reach and not stored in a locked cabinet.
Towels hanging on the oven handle and various small appliances on the counter may create minor clutter, potentially obstructing movement or causing distraction.
